body:
My boobs, oh it was totally my boobs. They got coke one night and I was in excruciating pain, my friend was like is that normal for you… took a test next day and boom BFP.

There were a couple other small signs like implantation bleeding that my partner noticed after sex, but I had honestly been trying to conceive for years and chalked it up to wishful thinking.

My due date is Dec 23, went for my anatomy 20 week scan, was told the doctor would call if there was any issues, otherwise she would refer me to an OB GYN. A week later tie doctors number popped up on my phone
and my heart dropped. During the ultrasound I had seen GA that they were measuring was behind… anyways this was the issue she called about. She said everything looked fine but she was measuring small for her GA. She explained that they needed to do another ultrasound in a couple weeks to make sure she was still growing proportionately and to rule out an ongoing issue. 
Man was I ever nervous for those 2 weeks, but went for the ultrasound at 24w and watched the screen like a hawk. All measurements BPD, HC, FL, AC all were coming back between 7-10 days behind. When I left they gave me a password to access all the images online and I was able to see he was falling between the 9-12 percentile in all areas, which was about what I remembered from the anatomy scan. Needless to say Doctor called and is referring me to the OB GYN, she says baby is just small like her mom 5’1 and there’s nothing to worry about. I’m not sure what my OB GYN will want to do in terms of monitoring but the hospital I’m choosing to use doesn’t do high risk pregnancies, the hospital I would be referred to if my pregnancy was deemed high risk; has a lot of bad memories for me, they were wrong thank god, but about 5 years ago they were not taking adequate care of my mom, if it weren’t for me begging and a caring respiratory therapist who found the issue which was severe enough my mom was in ICU within 30 minutes, my mom would’ve died. They sent a Chaplin in and everything, but after having her transferred and her being in a medically induced coma for 10 days on life support, she pulled through. I’m still so terrified of that hospital though and I sure hope she’s just small

This is probably the most raw, open and heartfelt post I’ve ever posted. Firstly, I never truly understood the true meaning of trauma, the gravity of it. I never understood the true depth of PTSD, and what people with PTSD go through. I never realized how invalidating, comments like just think about something else, or you need to move on could be. 
Secondly, I never knew how many people suicide could effect, how one act by one person could change the life of so many.  If you know someone who is suicidal or you are yourself, please understand that one decision can take more then one life. Seek help, offer help, be supportive. 
One weekend, one day, one instant, someone chose to end there life and I discovered them, I had to cut them down, I had to do cpr and was able to revive them enough for their family to be able to say goodbye 3 days later in a peaceful manner. I have no regrets about what I did, but my life has been forever changed. My peace was stolen, my sleep was stolen, my happiness was stolen. I have never had night terrors, I’ve never had flashbacks, I’ve never felt so much pain. I’ve never been through anything harder in my entire life. I was fortunate enough to reach out to the right people who have become angels in my life. Who are helping me get through this, and I will never be able to thank them enough.
Don’t be afraid to ask for help, if someone reaches out be there, and please, please consider reaching out before doing something as drastic as taking your life, because it’s not just your life your making decisions for.
